static_traits.name: Han Li
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends strained by constant focus on negative outcomes; have a few friends to discuss Average issues with, but have not yet discussed specific negative thoughts
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no history of psychotherapy or psychiatric treatment; no similar issues in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe weekend experiences and thoughts concretely; tendency to negate the positive, focusing only on the negative; skeptical of suggestions; Average cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I often negate the positive aspects of life, focusing on negative outcomes, for example believing I can never hike in the Appalachians, which makes me feel dissatisfied and despair.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thinking and dissatisfaction with my current situation drive me to seek counseling, to improve my mental health.
growth_experiences: After moving to a big city a few years ago I could no longer continue my habitual hiking, and often felt disconnected from nature on weekends, empty and lost; before the move, hiking brought me Freedom and joy. Over time this sense of loss persisted, affecting my enjoyment of weekends and straining relationships with friends (because I kept focusing on negative outcomes).

core_beliefs: I cannot possibly achieve what I truly want (like hiking in the Appalachians)

special_situations.event: Planned to visit a nearby park on the weekend, but thinking it is 'not at all the same' as hiking in the Appalachians, cancelled the outing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an activity does not meet the ideal standard (hiking in the Appalachians), doing it has no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding going out, staying home to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Going to the nearby park has no meaning

special_situations.event: When hiking on trails around the city, continuously compares with the Appalachian Trail, and the experience is overshadowed by negative thoughts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only hiking in the Appalachians counts as true happiness; other alternative activities are not worth it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes negative comparisons during activities and belittles experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These trails are not worth walking, I will only be more disappointed

special_situations.event: When thinking of future travel plans, predicting I can never go hike in the Appalachians
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Since I now live in a big city with limited conditions, the future will inevitably fail to realize my ideal
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not make feasible plans, sinking into negative prophecies to avoid having hope shattered
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never go to the Appalachians

special_situations.event: When Reflecting on the positive aspects of current life (stable Work, friends), immediately feeling these are 'insignificant'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive factors other than hiking are not important, unable to bring true satisfaction
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negate the positive, focus only on what is lost
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These positive aspects do not count

core_conflict.wish: Long for Freedom and deep connection with nature (the Freedom and joy gained from hiking)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of losing this connection, making life empty and Meaninglessness
defense_goal: Avoiding feeling disappointed again by belittling alternative activities and positive aspects
Maintain distance and avoidance to reduce Anxiety and Sense of frustration

object_relations.self_representation: A disheartened person deprived of Freedom
object_relations.object_representation: The city/environment is a force that restricts and blocks Freedom

object_relations.self_representation: A negative person hard to understand
object_relations.object_representation: Friends are others who cannot understand me, distant from me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to identify and acknowledge the positive aspects of current life or suggests alternative activities (e.g. visiting an art exhibition)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these positive aspects are 'insignificant/insincere', alternative activities 'have no meaning', hard to believe they will bring change (transference: distrust and devaluation of others' suggestions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond in a cautious, skeptical tone, emphasizing 'this is not the same / not meaningful', using reasons to Interpretation why the positive aspects are not important, avoiding deep emotional levels

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment or trying to participate in new activities with an open mindset
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equate trying with 'not changing anything', prematurely judging the outcome as ineffective (transference: the preset of turning expectations into disappointment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use brief, negating statements (e.g. 'no need''there will be no change'), maintain a reserved attitude, reduce investment in new experiences

manifestations: Feel empty on weekends and 'have no meaning'
Believe alternative activities are all not worth doing
Deprecating the positive aspects of current life
Feel Freedom and joy while hiking; feel trapped after moving to the big city
Connection with nature broken, experience limited

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to acceptance.
manifestations: In counseling avoid direct contact with the positive, quickly returning to comparisons of 'this is not the same / has no meaning'
When invited to try new activities, downplays their possible value in a doubtful tone

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Viewing experiences with rigid standards: only hiking in the Appalachians counts as 'true happiness'
Negate all other activities on the grounds of 'not meeting the ideal standard'

positive_force: Having a stable job and basic social support (a few friends)
Has a clear interest in and sense of value for nature and hiking
Willing to try participating in new activities (such as art exhibitions) with an open but cautious attitude
The problem has not yet significantly affected Work performance; functioning preserved
negative_force: Negating the positive and all-or-nothing thinking narrow experience
Predict the future, preset failure ('can never go to the Appalachians')
Persistent loss and emptiness from being disconnected from nature
Avoids alternative activities, fewer weekend activities
Interpersonal relationships strained by constant focus on the negative

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids going out on weekends and substitute outdoor activities (such as nearby parks and city trails)
antecedent: Thinking about the gap with the Appalachian hike
target_behavior.core_reason: Disconnection from nature after moving to the big city, accompanied by all-or-nothing thinking and the cognitive bias of negating the positive, making them see alternative activities as 'having no meaning', to avoid disappointment
target_behavior.function: Escape the emotions of disappointment and dissatisfaction, maintaining short-term emotional control
target_behavior.consequence: Fewer weekend activities, heavier emptiness, reinforcing the negative cognitive cycle

target_behavior.behavior: In interpersonal interactions, continuously emphasizes negative outcomes and belittles the positive, leading to relationship estrangement
antecedent: Exchanging updates or activity plans with friends
Others offer positive suggestions or alternative arrangements
target_behavior.core_reason: Long-term negative filtering and the 'negate the positive' cognitive style, trying to lower expectations by presetting failure for Self-protection
target_behavior.function: Gain self-consistent cognitive confirmation, avoiding the Anxiety of having expectations 'raised' by others
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension and estrangement, reduced Social support
